- When deleting saved data, it was confirmed that corrupt files could occur

notes.title: Trouble with art book
notes.notes: [p]The following are the problems we are currently confirming.[/p][p]We apologize for any inconvenience caused...[/p][p][/p][p]- Glitch where the art book can be viewed even if the DLC has not been purchased.[/p][p](Resolved but some users may still have artbooks in their local files.[/p][p]  For those who have not resolved the issue,[/p][p]  Uninstall->Reinstall this game from the Steam client should resolve the issue).[/p][p][/p][p]- Bug where DLC cannot be purchased even though it has not been purchased yet.[/p][p](We are currently investigating, please wait a while as we are in contact with Steam support...)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894598/3d50ba8d2654ce89ad23ed5c9ead207369a374fd.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: ver1.03.00
notes.notes:
- A difficulty level “Saveable” has been added after clearing.
- Added an item to the bookstore after clearing the game to make it easier to capture the ending.
- It is now possible to view the achieved EDs again on the ending screen.
- The ending confirmation screen now displays achievement hints even for endings that have already been completed.
- Added On/Off setting for skip effects.
- Fixed a bug that could cause different saved data to disappear when deleting saves on the load screen.
- Changed drop items in some battles.

notes.title: ver1.02.07
notes.notes:
- Some text corrections.
- Fixed a problem where some fixed defeat events could be won, so the balance has been adjusted and the event will progress even if the player wins.
- Fixed a bug where the skill to hold on to your strength at 1 sometimes did not work correctly.
- The electric knife technique has been revised downward.
